data.value: No cleanup keeps history visible. Logical cleanup hides history after a battle while retaining it in memory, so switching back to No cleanup restores it. data.name: ChatTtsModelInfoBody
data.value:
Choose an installed local model, or download/import one.
Recommended model: Kokoro v1.1 (Sherpa-ONNX, Chinese/English, 103 voices).
Import: currently only Sherpa-ONNX Kokoro TTS model folders are supported. The folder must contain model.onnx or model.int8.onnx, voices.bin, tokens.txt, and espeak-ng-data. Other model frameworks are not currently supported.
